editorial: Dhurandhar is a gritty, high-octane thriller that plunges into the brutal underbelly of Karachi, offering a masterclass in suspense and suspense. With phenomenal action choreography and an intense lead performance, the film doesn't just explore the corruption of the ISI nexus—it dismantles it with lethal precision. This is cinema that feels visceral, uncompromising, and absolutely electrifying from start to finish.
